free_design.Place: an outdoor hilltop orchard market with enormous pomelos stacked in open baskets under red canvas awnings
free_design.Activity: she tastes a thick pomelo segment, surprised by its sourness, with a restrained amused smile; the whole giant fruit rests in the crook of her left forearm
free_design.Pose: standing naturally three-quarter toward the camera, her right hand holds one small fruit segment near her mouth and her left forearm supports the whole pomelo against her waist, both arms clearly visible in front

free_design.Outfit: a rust-orange sleeveless origami-fold crop waistcoat with a deep angular neckline and cobalt barrel-shaped culotte shorts with overlapping rounded hems; fitted at the waist, bare shoulders and midriff, opaque intimate coverage
